title: Blow-up bounds under profile approximation for superconformal wave equations
summary: For the focusing semilinear wave equation in the superconformal, Sobolev-subcritical range, we prove an upper blow-up bound at the ODE rate near a non-characteristic point, assuming approximation by signed multiples of explicit stationary profiles in similarity variables. The comparison parameters may vary with time, and the error is measured only in a degenerate energy norm on a small extension of the unit ball.
